notes: The nucleoside of a base is encoded as the base being part_of its nucleoside (no catalogued relation for it). The letter U is a surface of uracil (no catalogued abbreviation relation). GC content is the class GcBase of guanine and cytosine. velquarine is fictional; uracil is not one of the four natural DNA bases, so dna_partner_of(velquarine, uracil) fills an empty slot.

bridge_refs.uridine_of_uracil: The ribonucleoside of uracil is uridine.
bridge_refs.gc_content: GC content is the share of a DNA molecule's bases that are guanine or cytosine.
